about: equinox microphone corrections. Each entry is a set of Equalizer APO filters that evens out the microphone's own voicing (presence peaks, thin low end) so your profile starts from a neutral voice. Unless an entry says otherwise it is approximated from the manufacturer's published frequency response chart, not measured in a lab: treat it as a starting point and use the strength slider. Better data is welcome as a pull request.

mics.note: Flat switch setting. Eases the upper-mid presence and restores the top end.

ON HSC Fc 12000 Hz Gain 2.0 dB Q 0.7
